intro: CAVA is a Mediterranean fast-casual chain where you build your own bowl or pita down the line, much like Chipotle but with Mediterranean flavors. You pick a base of greens or grains, a protein, then dips, spreads, toppings and dressings. One price covers your base and most toppings, with premium proteins like braised lamb or beef costing a little more. Below is the full CAVA menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: A build-your-own CAVA bowl starts around $10.78 and a pita around $10.06 with chicken, falafel, grilled meatballs or roasted vegetables. Braised lamb or beef adds about $2.30, and spicy lamb meatballs add about $2.00. A side of pita chips is about $1.81 and a pick-three dips plus chips is about $8.63.
hot_deal: CAVA Rewards and app offers: CAVA runs app and loyalty promos through the year, plus seasonal proteins and dressings for a limited time. CAVA also posts full nutrition, so you can check calories for every ingredient. Offers vary, so check the CAVA app.

faqs.q: How much is a bowl at CAVA?
faqs.a: A build-your-own CAVA bowl starts around $10.78 with chicken, falafel, grilled meatballs or roasted vegetables. Braised lamb or beef adds about $2.30 and spicy lamb meatballs add about $2.00. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a CAVA bowl and a pita?
faqs.a: A bowl is served over greens, grains or both, while a pita is wrapped in warm pita bread. The pita is usually a little cheaper, starting around $10.06 versus $10.78 for a bowl.

CAVA offers grilled chicken, harissa honey chicken, falafel, grilled meatballs and roasted vegetables at the base price, plus premium spicy lamb meatballs, braised lamb and braised beef for a little more.

faqs.q: What are CAVA's dips and spreads?
faqs.a: Signature dips and spreads include hummus, roasted red pepper hummus, crazy feta (whipped spicy feta), tzatziki and harissa. They are included in a build, and you can also get a pick-three dips plus chips for about $8.63.

Yes. CAVA posts full nutrition for every ingredient, so you can add up the calories for your exact build. Because bowls and pitas are built to order, the total depends on your base, protein, dips and toppings.

The format is similar: you build your own bowl or pita down the line. The difference is the cuisine, with CAVA focused on Mediterranean flavors like hummus, feta, harissa and pita instead of Mexican ingredients.
